annotations.text:
Panda rebuild.

Head came down from rx 59 to rx 47 against a bigger body, and the two now overlap by about 16 units so it reads as one animal instead of a head balanced on a snowman.

Eyes are glossy black orbs on an almost-black patch. The white shine is what makes them read as eyes, so it does the work the old white sclera was doing, without the wide-eyed cartoon look.

Artboard 3 is the one to watch.

The panda now rides the write head. Each word carries its own panda sitting right after it, and only the one at the current write position shows, so it rolls forward into each new word as that word fades up out of a blur.

The slots are zero width, so an invisible panda never spaces out the text, and because they sit in the text flow the head follows line wraps on its own. When the last word lands the head is gone and the seated panda settles into the avatar slot facing you.
Explain lives in the right rail as an outline box, green when on. The depth slider only appears while it is on. Artboard 4 shows what off looks like: the answer alone, nothing else.
